annotations.title: Screen a name against EU, UN, UK and US sanctions (paid)

description: Use when you must check whether a person or company is under sanctions: screens the name against the EU, UN, UK and US OFAC lists (25,000+ persons, companies and vessels with aliases, refreshed weekly). Fuzzy matching handles spelling, transliteration and word order; returns scored possible matches with lists, references and birth dates. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

name.description: Person or organisation name, e.g. 'Vladimir Putin'
